jobs.title: Security Guard Full Time Unarmed Access Verification Patrol
jobs.description:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.



As a Security Guard Full Time Unarmed Access Verification Patrol in Austin, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Financial Institutions, and more. As an Unarmed Patrol Officer at a financial institution, you will monitor and patrol assigned areas, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, support access control, and provide outstanding customer service. You will communicate professionally with employees, visitors, and guests while contributing to a welcoming environment. Join Allied Universal, where agile, reliable, innovative teams put people first and act with integrity.

Position Type: Full Time

Pay Rate: $23.00 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTime
Mon08:30 AM - 05:30 PM
Tue08:30 AM - 05:30 PM
Wed08:30 AM - 05:30 PM
Thur08:30 AM - 12:30 PM
Fri08:30 AM - 05:30 PM

What You'll Do:

  • Provide customer service to employees, visitors, and customers at a financial institution by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and, when appropriate, emergency response activities.
  • Monitor access points and visitor activity, verify credentials as required, and maintain accurate logs and reports in accordance with site procedures.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, escalating concerns to appropriate personnel and/or emergency services as directed.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols of the facility, parking areas, entrances, and perimeter to help deter unauthorized activity and identify security-related concerns.
  • Communicate professionally with bank personnel, customers, and law enforcement while supporting a professional and welcoming environment.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Have at least one year of security-related experience.
  • Be at least 21 years of age.
  • Access control and badge experience is preferred.
  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • Comfort using a computer or tablet is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.

Job Title: New! Experienced Professional Security Officers (All Shifts) - Austin ($18.00/HR)

Job Type: Full-time (Must Be Able To Start Immediately)

Location: Austin, TX

Salary: $18.00 Hourly


Job Description:

We are hiring full-time security officers with open availability to join our team. The ideal candidate will be available to work full-time with the ability to work any shift and weekends /holidays as needed with the ability to meet the physical demands of foot patrols. Officers are responsible for providing safety and security services to our clients by carrying out site-specific policies, safety procedures, and emergency response protocols.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide customer service to clients by carrying out safety and security procedures
  • Respond to emergencies and assist as needed
  • Monitor and report suspicious activities
  • Conduct regular patrols of the premises
  • Ensure the safety of all personnel and visitors
  • Maintain accurate records of all incidents and activities

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Must have a valid driver’s license
  • Must have a valid level II Texas security license
  • Must be able to pass a background check and drug screening
  • Must be able to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays
  • Must have excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Must have 2 years of security experience
  • Prior Flex Officer experience is preferred
“Join our team and enjoy the benefits of working with us! We offer health benefits to all our employees after 60 days. Additionally, we provide an employee retention bonus after one year of service, to show our appreciation for your hard work and dedication. We believe in creating a positive work environment that values our employees and their contributions. Come join us and be a part of our growing team!”
